rows.english: {region}. {note}Planning reference when established; confirm local picking dates. No food quantity or first-year crop promised.
rows.zu: {region}. {note}Isikhombo sokuhlela lapho sekumile kahle; qinisekisa izinsuku zokuvuna zendawo. Akuthenjiswa inani lokudla noma isivuno sonyaka wokuqala.
rows.st: {region}. {note}Mohlodi wa moralo ha dimela di se di tsitsitse; netefatsa matsatsi a kotulo sebakeng. Ha ho bongata ba dijo kapa kotulo ya selemo sa pele e tshepisitsweng.
rows.ts: {region}. {note}Xikombo xo kunguhata loko swi mile swi tiya; tiyisisa masiku yo tshovela ya ndhawu. A ku na nhlayo ya swakudya kumbe ntshovelo wa lembe ro sungula lowu tshembisiweke.
rows.ve: {region}. {note}Tshiko tsha u pulana musi zwo no khwaṱha; khwaṱhisedzani maḓuvha a u kaṋa a henefho. A hu na tshivhalo tsha zwiḽiwa kana khaṋo ya ṅwaha wa u thoma zwo fulufhedziswaho.

rows.english: Hot and cool main crops remain separate; smaller additional crops are not marked.
rows.zu: Izivuno eziyinhloko zezindawo ezishisayo nezipholile zigcinwa zihlukene; izivuno ezengeziwe ezincane azimakwa.
rows.st: Dikotulo tse kgolo tsa dibaka tse tjhesang le tse phodileng di dula di arohane; dikotulo tse ding tse nyane ha di tshwaiwe.
rows.ts: Mintshovelo leyikulu ya tindhawu to hisa ni to titimela yi hambana; mintshovelo leyitsongo leyi engetelekeke a yi funghiwi.
rows.ve: Khaṋo khulwane dza fhethu hu fhisaho na hu rotholelaho dzi dzula dzo fhambana; khaṋo ṱhukhu dzo engedzwaho a dzi swaiwi.

rows.english: Reference first pick, not the whole harvest duration.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sokuvuna kokuqala, hhayi sonke isikhathi sesivuno.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa kotulo ya pele, eseng nako yohle ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ku tshovela ko sungula, ku nga ri nkarhi hinkwawo wa ntshovelo.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha u kaṋa ha u thoma, hu si tshifhinga tshoṱhe tsha khaṋo.

rows.english: Elgin first-pick reference, not the whole harvest duration. No other apple cultivar months are joined to it.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sokuvuna kokuqala sase-Elgin, hhayi sonke isikhathi sesivuno. Azihlanganiswa naso izinyanga zezinye izinhlobo ze-apple.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa kotulo ya pele wa Elgin, eseng nako yohle ya kotulo. Ha ho dikgwedi tsa mefuta e meng ya apple tse kopanngwang le wona.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ku tshovela ko sungula xa Elgin, ku nga ri nkarhi hinkwawo wa ntshovelo. A ku hlanganisiwi tin’hweti ta mixaka yin’wana ya apple eka xona.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha u kaṋa ha u thoma tsha Elgin, hu si tshifhinga tshoṱhe tsha khaṋo. A hu ṱanganyiswi miṅwedzi ya dziṅwe tshaka dza apple kha tshone.

rows.english: Reference first pick; confirm chilling and compatible pollinator.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sokuvuna kokuqala; qinisekisa amakhaza adingekayo nesitshalo esifanele sempova.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa kotulo ya pele; netefatsa serame se hlokahalang le semela se fanang ka peo ya palesa se dumellanang.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ku tshovela ko sungula; tiyisisa xirhami ni ximilana lexi fambisanaka xo nyikela pollen.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha u kaṋa ha u thoma; khwaṱhisedzani phepho na tshimela tshi tshimbidzanaho tsha u ṋea pollen.

rows.english: KZN outdoor reference, not the Transvaal tunnel season.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sangaphandle sase-KZN, hhayi isikhathi semihubhe yase-Transvaal.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa temo ya kantle wa KZN, eseng nako ya ditanele tsa Transvaal.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa le handle xa KZN, ku nga ri nguva ya tithanele ta Transvaal.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha nnḓa tsha KZN, hu si khalaṅwaha ya thaneḽe dza Transvaal.

rows.english: Assumes light frost; check severity locally.
rows.zu: Kucatshangwa isithwathwa esincane; hlola ubukhulu baso endaweni.
rows.st: Ho hakanyetswa serame sa lehlwa se bobebe; hlahloba matla a sona sebakeng.
rows.ts: Ku ringanyetiwa gwitsi ritsongo; kambela ku tika ka rona endhawini.
rows.ve: Hu anganyelwa luvhame luṱuku; sedzulusani vhuhulu halwo henefho.

rows.english: Irrigated production reference; confirm cultivar, pollination, summer heat and water capacity.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sokukhiqiza okuniselwa; qinisekisa uhlobo, impova, ukushisa kwasehlobo namandla amanzi.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa tlhahiso e nosetswang; netefatsa mofuta, ho fetisa peo ya palesa, motjheso wa lehlabula le bokgoni ba metsi.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa vuhumelerisi byo cheletiwa; tiyisisa muxaka, ku rhurhisa pollen, ku hisa ka ximumu ni vuswikoti bya mati.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha mveledzo ya u sheledza; khwaṱhisedzani lushaka, u tshimbidza pollen, mufhiso wa tshilimo na vhukoni ha maḓi.

rows.english: KZN regional reference; cultivar-specific local timing remains unknown.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sesifunda sase-KZN; isikhathi sendawo esiqondene nohlobo sisengaziwa.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sebaka wa KZN; nako ya sebaka e tobileng mofuta o itseng e ntse e sa tsejwe.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa xifundzha xa KZN; nkarhi wa ndhawu wa muxaka wo karhi wa ha nga tiveki.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha dzingu tsha KZN; tshifhinga tsha henefho tsha lushaka lwo khetheaho a tshi athu ḓivhea.

rows.english: Regional nut-in-shell season; individual cultivar maturity still needs checking.
rows.zu: Isikhathi sesifunda samantongomane asemagobolondweni; ukuvuthwa kohlobo ngalunye kusadinga ukuhlolwa.
rows.st: Nako ya sebaka ya matokomane a leng dikgetleng; ho butswa ha mofuta ka mong ho ntse ho hloka ho hlahlojwa.
rows.ts: Nguva ya xifundzha ya timanga leti nga emakambeni; ku wupfa ka muxaka wun’wana ni wun’wana ka ha fanele ku kamberiwa.
rows.ve: Khalaṅwaha ya dzingu ya nḓuhu dzi re kha maganda; u vhibva ha lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe hu kha ḓi fanela u sedzuluswa.

rows.english: Regional industry season, not a Tommy Atkins-only harvest window.
rows.zu: Isikhathi semboni sesifunda, hhayi isikhathi sesivuno se-Tommy Atkins kuphela.
rows.st: Nako ya indasteri ya sebaka, eseng nako ya kotulo ya Tommy Atkins feela.
rows.ts: Nguva ya indasitiri ya xifundzha, ku nga ri nkarhi wa ntshovelo wa Tommy Atkins ntsena.
rows.ve: Khalaṅwaha ya nḓowetshumo ya dzingu, hu si tshifhinga tsha khaṋo ya Tommy Atkins fhedzi.

rows.english: Cool subtropical KZN reference; heavier and secondary crops only.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sezindawo ezifudumele ezipholile zase-KZN; izivuno ezinkulu nezesibili kuphela.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa KZN wa sebaka sa subtropical se phodileng; dikotulo tse boima le tsa bobedi feela.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa KZN xa ndhawu ya subtropical yo titimela; mintshovelo leyikulu ni ya vumbirhi ntsena.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha KZN tsha fhethu ha subtropical hu rotholelaho; khaṋo khulwane na dza vhuvhili fhedzi.

rows.english: Spring-bearing system only; do not use this for autumn-bearing Heritage or Autumn Bliss.
rows.zu: Uhlelo oluthela entwasahlobo kuphela; ungalusebenzisi ku-Heritage noma ku-Autumn Bliss ethela ekwindla.
rows.st: Ke mokgwa o behang nakong ya selemo feela; o se ke wa o sebedisa bakeng sa Heritage kapa Autumn Bliss tse behang hwetla.
rows.ts: I maendlelo yo tswala hi ximun’wana ntsena; u nga ma tirhisi eka Heritage kumbe Autumn Bliss leti tswalaka hi xixikana.
rows.ve: Ndi sisiṱeme ya u aṋwa nga luṱavula fhedzi; ni songo i shumisa kha Heritage kana Autumn Bliss dzine dza aṋwa nga tshifhefho.

rows.english: Hex River/Wolseley trial reference; confirm cultivar, chilling and acidic soil.
rows.zu: Isikhombo socwaningo sase-Hex River/Wolseley; qinisekisa uhlobo, amakhaza adingekayo nomhlabathi one-asidi.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa teko wa Hex River/Wolseley; netefatsa mofuta, serame se hlokahalang le mobu o nang le asiti.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ndzingo xa Hex River/Wolseley; tiyisisa muxaka, xirhami ni misava ya asidi.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha ndingo tsha Hex River/Wolseley; khwaṱhisedzani lushaka, phepho na mavu a asidi.

rows.english: Breede River main-crop reference; cultivar and local dates still need checking.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sesivuno esiyinhloko sase-Breede River; uhlobo nezinsuku zendawo kusadinga ukuhlolwa.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa kotulo e kgolo wa Breede River; mofuta le matsatsi a sebaka di ntse di hloka ho hlahlojwa.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ntshovelo lowukulu xa Breede River; muxaka ni masiku ya ndhawu swa ha fanele ku kamberiwa.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha khaṋo khulwane tsha Breede River; lushaka na maḓuvha a henefho zwi kha ḓi fanela u sedzuluswa.

rows.english: Satsuma group reference; other soft-citrus varieties have different seasons.
rows.zu: Isikhombo seqembu le-Satsuma; ezinye izinhlobo ze-soft-citrus zinezikhathi ezihlukile.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sehlopha sa Satsuma; mefuta e meng ya soft-citrus e na le dinako tse fapaneng.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ntlawa wa Satsuma; mixaka yin’wana ya soft-citrus yi ni tinguva to hambana.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha tshigwada tsha Satsuma; dziṅwe tshaka dza soft-citrus dzi na khalaṅwaha dzo fhambanaho.

rows.english: SA industry reference, not a Wonderful-only window.
rows.zu: Isikhombo semboni yase-SA, hhayi isikhathi se-Wonderful kuphela.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa indasteri ya SA, eseng nako ya Wonderful feela.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa indasitiri ya SA, ku nga ri nkarhi wa Wonderful ntsena.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha nḓowetshumo ya SA, hu si tshifhinga tsha Wonderful fhedzi.

rows.english: Frost-free forest reference; confirm a fruiting female and pollen source.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sehlathi elingenasithwathwa; qinisekisa isitshalo esiyinsikazi esithelayo nomthombo wempova.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa moru o se nang serame sa lehlwa; netefatsa semela sa tshehadi se behang le mohlodi wa peo ya palesa.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa khwati leri nga riki na gwitsi; tiyisisa ximilana xa xisati lexi tswalaka ni xihlovo xa pollen.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha ḓaka ḽi si na luvhame; khwaṱhisedzani tshimela tsha tshisadzi tshi aṋwaho na tshiko tsha pollen.

rows.english: Summer-rain reference; check frost protection of young plants.
rows.zu: Isikhombo semvula yasehlobo; hlola ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo ezincane esithwathweni.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa pula ya lehlabula; hlahloba tshireletso ya dimela tse nyane kgahlanong le serame sa lehlwa.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa mpfula ya ximumu; kambela nsirhelelo wa swimila leswitsongo eka gwitsi.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha mvula ya tshilimo; sedzulusani tsireledzo ya zwimela zwiṱuku kha luvhame.

rows.english: Broad SANBI fruiting reference; local season may be shorter.
rows.zu: Isikhombo esibanzi sokuthela se-SANBI; isikhathi sendawo singaba sifushane.
rows.st: Mohlodi o pharaletseng wa SANBI wa ho beha; nako ya sebaka e ka ba kgutshwane.
rows.ts: Xikombo xo anama xa SANBI xa ku tswala; nguva ya ndhawu yi nga va yo koma.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsho ṱanḓavhuwaho tsha SANBI tsha u aṋwa; khalaṅwaha ya henefho i nga vha pfufhi.

rows.english: Fruit, not flowering; check moisture and fruiting female stock.
rows.zu: Izithelo, hhayi ukuqhakaza; hlola umswakama nezitshalo eziyinsikazi ezithelayo.
rows.st: Ditholwana, eseng ho thunya; hlahloba mongobo le dimela tsa tshehadi tse behang.
rows.ts: Mihandzu, ku nga ri ku rhumbuka; kambela ndzhongho ni swimila swa xisati leswi tswalaka.
rows.ve: Mitshelo, hu si u ṱuma maluvha; sedzulusani muṋando na zwimela zwa tshisadzi zwi aṋwaho.

rows.english: Ripe fruit only; tuberous roots are poisonous.
rows.zu: Izithelo ezivuthiwe kuphela; izimpande ezinezilimo eziyizigaxa zinobuthi.
rows.st: Ke ditholwana tse butswitseng feela; metso e metenya ya polokelo e na le tjhefo.
rows.ts: I mihandzu leyi wupfeke ntsena; timitsu leti kuleke ta vuhlayiselo ti ni chefu.
rows.ve: Ndi mitshelo yo vhibvaho fhedzi; midzi yo kukumalaho ya u vhulunga i na mulimo.

rows.english: Fruit reference, not a separate kernel season; check fruiting female stock.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sezithelo, hhayi isikhathi esihlukile sezinhlamvu zangaphakathi; hlola izitshalo eziyinsikazi ezithelayo.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa ditholwana, eseng nako e arohaneng ya thollo e ka hare; hlahloba dimela tsa tshehadi tse behang.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa mihandzu, ku nga ri nguva leyi hambaneke ya timbilu ta tindzoho; kambela swimila swa xisati leswi tswalaka.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha mitshelo, hu si khalaṅwaha yo fhambanaho ya mbilwana dza mbeu; sedzulusani zwimela zwa tshisadzi zwi aṋwaho.

rows.english: Ripe pulp only; seeds and unripe fruit are toxic.
rows.zu: Inyama yesithelo evuthiwe kuphela; imbewu nezithelo ezingakavuthwa zinobuthi.
rows.st: Ke nama ya tholwana e butswitseng feela; dipeo le ditholwana tse sa butswang di na le tjhefo.
rows.ts: I nyama ya muhandzu leyi wupfeke ntsena; timbewu ni mihandzu leyi nga wupfangiki swi ni chefu.
rows.ve: Ndi ṋama ya mutshelo yo vhibvaho fhedzi; mbeu na mitshelo i songo vhibvaho zwi na mulimo.

rows.english: Moist-position reference; fruit dates are not honey-flow dates.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sendawo enomswakama; izinsuku zezithelo akuzona izinsuku zokutholakala koju.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sebaka se mongobo; matsatsi a ditholwana ha se matsatsi a tlhahiso ya mahe a dinotshi.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa ndhawu ya ndzhongho; masiku ya mihandzu a hi masiku ya vuhumelerisi bya vulombe.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha fhethu ha muṋando; maḓuvha a mitshelo a si maḓuvha a u wana mutoli.

rows.english: Northern production-region reference, not the national November–May union.
rows.zu: Isikhombo sesifunda sokukhiqiza sasenyakatho, hhayi ukuhlanganiswa kukaNovemba–Meyi kuzwelonke.
rows.st: Mohlodi wa sebaka sa tlhahiso sa leboya, eseng kopanyo ya naha ya Pudungwana–Motsheanong.
rows.ts: Xikombo xa xifundzha xa vuhumelerisi xa le n’walungwini, ku nga ri ku hlanganisiwa ka Hukuri–Mudyaxihi ka tiko.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha dzingu ḽa mveledzo ḽa devhula, hu si u ṱanganyiswa ha Lara–Shundunthule ha lushaka.

rows.english: Food and growing space
rows.st: Dijo le sebaka sa temo

rows.zu: Izinketho zokudla ezaziwayo ngenyanga. Kubalwa kanye ngesitshalo noma ngomkhiqizo, hhayi amakhilogremu, izingxenye noma ukudla okudliwayo.
rows.st: Dikgetho tsa dijo tse tsejwang ka kgwedi. Di balwa hang ka sejalo kapa sehlahiswa, eseng dikhilograma, dikarolo kapa dijo tsa nako ya ho ja.
rows.ts: Swakudya leswi tivekaka hi n’hweti. Swi hlayiwa kan’we hi xibyariwa kumbe xikumiwa, ku nga ri tikhilogiramu, swiphemu kumbe swakudya swa nkarhi wo dya.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa zwi ḓivheaho nga ṅwedzi. Zwi vhalwa luthihi nga tshiliṅwa kana tshibveledzwa, hu si khilogiramu, zwipiḓa kana zwiḽiwa zwa tshifhinga tsha u ḽa.

rows.english: Repeat-year comparison, not a first-year harvest forecast. Preserved stock records use exact dates.
rows.zu: Ukuqhathanisa konyaka ophindayo, hhayi isibikezelo sesivuno sonyaka wokuqala. Amarekhodi okudla okugciniwe asebenzisa izinsuku eziqondile.
rows.st: Papiso ya selemo se iphetang, eseng ponelopele ya kotulo ya selemo sa pele. Direkoto tsa dijo tse bolokilweng di sebedisa matsatsi a tobileng.
rows.ts: Ku fananisa ka lembe leri phindhaka, ku nga ri mvhumbo wa ntshovelo wa lembe ro sungula. Tirhekhodo ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke ti tirhisa masiku lama kongomeke.
rows.ve: Mbambedzo ya ṅwaha une wa dovholola, hu si mbonelaphanḓa ya khaṋo ya ṅwaha wa u thoma. Rekhodo dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho dzi shumisa maḓuvha o livhaho.

rows.english: No mapped bed or plot area is supplied, so used and free space cannot be shown.
rows.zu: Ayikho indawo yemibhede noma yezinsimu esebalazweni enikeziwe, ngakho indawo esetshenzisiwe nengasetshenzisiwe ayikwazi ukuboniswa.
rows.st: Ha ho sebaka sa dibethe kapa masimo a mmapeng se fanweng, kahoo sebaka se sebedisitsweng le se sa sebediswang se ke ke sa bontshwa.
rows.ts: A ku nyikiwanga ndhawu ya mibedo kumbe masimu ya le mepeni, kutani ndhawu leyi tirhisiweke ni leyi nga tirhisiwangiki a yi nge kombisiwi.
rows.ve: A hu na fhethu ha mibete kana masimu a re kha mapa ho ṋewaho, ngauralo fhethu ho shumiswaho na hu sa shumiswi a hu koni u sumbedzwa.

rows.english: The two food charts share a scale. A crop present fresh and kept still counts once; kept colours add other food kinds. Dated output records update fresh counts. Research season references and sources without local dates are outside food counts.
rows.zu: Amashadi amabili okudla asebenzisa isilinganiso esifanayo. Isitshalo esikhona sisisha futhi sigciniwe sibalwa kanye kuphela; imibala yokugciniwe yengeza ezinye izinhlobo zokudla. Amarekhodi okukhiqiza anezinsuku abuyekeza izibalo zokudla okusha. Izinkomba zocwaningo zezikhathi zonyaka nemithombo engenazo izinsuku zendawo azifakwa ezibalweni zokudla.
rows.st: Ditjhate tse pedi tsa dijo di sebedisa sekala se tshwanang. Sejalo se leng teng se le setjha mme se bolokilwe se ntse se balwa hang feela; mebala ya tse bolokilweng e eketsa mefuta e meng ya dijo. Direkoto tsa tlhahiso tse nang le matsatsi di ntlafatsa dipalo tsa dijo tse ntjha. Mehlodi ya dipatlisiso ya dinako tsa selemo le mehlodi e se nang matsatsi a sebaka ha e kenngwe dipalong tsa dijo.
rows.ts: Tichati timbirhi ta swakudya ti tirhisa xikalo xin’we. Xibyariwa lexi nga kona xi ri xo basa ni lexi hlayisiweke xi ha hlayiwa kan’we; mihlovo ya leswi hlayisiweke yi engetela mixaka yin’wana ya swakudya. Tirhekhodo ta vuhumelerisi leti nga ni masiku ti pfuxeta tinhlayo ta swakudya swo basa. Swikombo swa ndzavisiso swa tinguva ni swihlovo leswi nga riki na masiku ya ndhawu a swi katsiwi eka tinhlayo ta swakudya.
rows.ve: Tshati mbili dza zwiḽiwa dzi shumisa tshikalo tshithihi. Tshiliṅwa tshi re hone tshi tshiswa na tsho vhulungwaho tshi kha ḓi vhalwa luthihi; mivhala ya zwo vhulungwaho i engedza dziṅwe tshaka dza zwiḽiwa. Rekhodo dza mveledzo dzi re na maḓuvha dzi khwinisa mbalo dza zwiḽiwa zwiswa. Zwiko zwa ṱhoḓisiso zwa khalaṅwaha na zwiko zwi si na maḓuvha a henefho a zwi katelwi kha mbalo dza zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: Pantry storage requires each crop's source conditions. Preserved stock is shown only for recorded months; no amount, recipe or safe shelf life is inferred.
rows.zu: Ukugcina ukudla kudinga imibandela yomthombo yesitshalo ngasinye. Ukudla okulondoloziwe kuboniswa ezinyangeni ezirekhodiwe kuphela; akucatshangwa inani, indlela yokulungisa noma isikhathi sokugcina esiphephile.
rows.st: Poloko ya dijo e hloka maemo a mohlodi a sejalo ka seng. Dijo tse bolokilweng di bontshwa feela dikgweding tse rekotilweng; ha ho bongata, risepe kapa nako e bolokehileng ya poloko e hakanyetswang.
rows.ts: Vuhlayiselo bya swakudya byi lava swiyimo swa xihlovo swa xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana. Swakudya leswi hlayisiweke swi kombisiwa eka tin’hweti leti rhekhodiweke ntsena; a ku ringanyetiwi nhlayo, ndlela yo lulamisa kumbe nkarhi lowu hlayisekeke wo hlayisa.
rows.ve: U vhulunga zwiḽiwa hu ṱoḓa nyimele dza tshiko dza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe. Zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho zwi sumbedzwa kha miṅwedzi yo rekhodiwaho fhedzi; a hu anganyelwi tshivhalo, risipi kana tshifhinga tsho tsireledzeaho tsha u vhulunga.

rows.english: No preservation records supplied. Frozen, dried, fermented and processed food are not inferred from fresh harvest.
rows.zu: Awekho amarekhodi okulondoloza anikeziwe. Ukudla okuqandisiwe, okomisiwe, okuvutshelwe nokulungisiwe akucatshangwa kusukela esivunweni esisha.
rows.st: Ha ho direkoto tsa poloko tse fanweng. Dijo tse hoamisitsweng, tse omisitsweng, tsa ho bela (fermentation) le tse sebetsitsweng ha di hakanyetswe ho tswa kotulong e ntjha.
rows.ts: A ku nyikiwanga tirhekhodo ta vuhlayiselo. Swakudya leswi gwitsirisiweke, leswi omisiweke, swa mbiriso ni leswi lulamisiweke a swi ringanyetiwi ku suka eka ntshovelo wo basa.
rows.ve: A hu na rekhodo dza u vhulunga dzo ṋewaho. Zwiḽiwa zwo xwatuwaho, zwo omiswaho, zwa mbiliso na zwo shumiwaho a zwi anganyelwi u bva kha khaṋo ntswa.

rows.english: No preserved stock is recorded. This is a record status, not proof that the farm has no stock.
rows.zu: Akukho kudla okulondoloziwe okurekhodiwe. Lesi yisimo serekhodi, hhayi ubufakazi bokuthi ipulazi alinakho ukudla okugciniwe.
rows.st: Ha ho dijo tse bolokilweng tse rekotilweng. Sena ke boemo ba rekoto, eseng bopaki ba hore polasi ha e na dijo tse bolokilweng.
rows.ts: A ku rhekhodiwanga swakudya leswi hlayisiweke. Lexi i xiyimo xa rhekhodo, ku nga ri vumbhoni bya leswaku purasi a ri na swakudya leswi hlayisiweke.
rows.ve: A hu na zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho zwo rekhodiwaho. Itshi ndi tshiimo tsha rekhodo, hu si vhuṱanzi ha uri bulasi a ḽi na zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho.

rows.english: No kept-stock records are shown for the selected food categories.
rows.zu: Awekho amarekhodi okudla okugciniwe abonisiwe ezigabeni zokudla ezikhethiwe.
rows.st: Ha ho direkoto tsa dijo tse bolokilweng tse bontshitsweng dihlopheng tsa dijo tse kgethilweng.
rows.ts: A ku kombisiwanga tirhekhodo ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke eka swiyenge swa swakudya leswi hlawuriweke.
rows.ve: A hu na rekhodo dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho dzo sumbedzwaho kha zwigwada zwa zwiḽiwa zwo nangwaho.

rows.english: Preservation methods recorded: {methods}.
rows.st: Mekgwa ya poloko e rekotilweng: {methods}.
rows.ts: Tindlela ta vuhlayiselo leti rhekhodiweke: {methods}.
rows.ve: Nḓila dza u vhulunga dzo rekhodiwaho: {methods}.

rows.english: Space is for {area} m2 of mapped beds and plots only; trees, animal housing and ponds are outside this area. Numbers above space bars show used m2.
rows.zu: Indawo ingu-{area} m2 wemibhede nezinsimu ezisebalazweni kuphela; izihlahla, izindawo zezilwane namachibi kungaphandle kwale ndawo. Izibalo ezingaphezulu kwemigqa yendawo zibonisa ama-m2 asetshenzisiwe.
rows.st: Sebaka ke sa {area} m2 sa dibethe le masimo a mmapeng feela; difate, matlo a diphoofolo le matamo di ka ntle ho sebaka sena. Dipalo tse ka hodima dibara tsa sebaka di bontsha m2 tse sebedisitsweng.
rows.ts: Ndhawu i ya {area} m2 ya mibedo ni masimu ya le mepeni ntsena; mirhi, tindlu ta swifuwo ni mativa swi le handle ka ndhawu leyi. Tinhlayo leti nga ehenhla ka tibara ta ndhawu ti komba m2 leyi tirhisiweke.
rows.ve: Fhethu ndi ha {area} m2 ha mibete na masimu zwi re kha mapa fhedzi; miri, madzulo a zwifuwo na matavha zwi nnḓa ha afha fhethu. Mbalo dzi re nṱha ha mabara a fhethu dzi sumbedza m2 dzo shumiswaho.

rows.english: Some beds or plots have overlapping or invalid planting shares. Used space is capped at their mapped area; resolve the layout before relying on this comparison.
rows.zu: Eminye imibhede noma izinsimu inezingxenye zokutshala ezidlulanayo noma ezingavumelekile. Indawo esetshenzisiwe ikhawulwa endaweni esebalazweni; lungisa ukuhleleka ngaphambi kokuthembela kulokhu kuqhathanisa.
rows.st: Dibethe kapa masimo a mang a na le dikarolo tsa ho lema tse kopanang kapa tse sa nepahalang. Sebaka se sebedisitsweng se lekanyeditswe sebakeng sa tsona se mmapeng; lokisa moralo pele o tshepa papiso ena.
rows.ts: Mibedo kumbe masimu man’wana swi ni swiphemu swo byala leswi tlulanaka kumbe leswi nga riki swona. Ndhawu leyi tirhisiweke yi pimiwa eka ndhawu ya swona ya le mepeni; lulamisa dizayini u nga si titshega hi ku fananisa loku.
rows.ve: Miṅwe mibete kana masimu zwi na zwipiḓa zwa u ṱavha zwi pfukanaho kana zwi songo teaho. Fhethu ho shumiswaho hu pimiwa kha fhethu hazwo hu re kha mapa; lulamisani dizaini phanḓa ha u fulufhela uyu mbambedzo.

rows.ts: Mintiko ya vuhumelerisi
rows.ve: Zwileme zwa mveledzo

rows.ts: Mintiko ya vuhumelerisi ni tirhekhodo leti kayivelaka
rows.ve: Zwileme zwa mveledzo na rekhodo dzi siho

rows.english: Monthly records, crop-cycle benchmarks and food kept in stock are separate measures. Missing quantities are not zero.
rows.zu: Amarekhodi enyanga, izilinganiso zemijikelezo yezitshalo nokudla okugciniwe kuyizilinganiso ezihlukene. Amanani angekho awasho uziro.
rows.st: Direkoto tsa kgwedi, ditekanyo tsa medikoloho ya dijalo le dijo tse bolokilweng ke ditekanyo tse arohaneng. Bongata bo siyo ha bo bolele noto.
rows.ts: Tirhekhodo ta n’hweti, mimpimo ya mindzhendzheleko ya swibyariwa ni swakudya leswi hlayisiweke i mimpimo leyi hambaneke. Tinhlayo leti kayivelaka a hi ziro.
rows.ve: Rekhodo dza ṅwedzi, zwikalo zwa mutevhe ya zwiliṅwa na zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho ndi zwikalo zwo fhambanaho. Zwivhalo zwi siho a si zero.

rows.english: Monthly kg records
rows.st: Direkoto tsa kg tsa kgwedi
rows.ts: Tirhekhodo ta kg ta n’hweti
rows.ve: Rekhodo dza kg dza ṅwedzi

rows.english: Green bars contain actual kg records only. Gold bars include expected kg. Actual replaces expected for the same food source and month. These are known subtotals; missing crop, tree and animal quantities stay outside them.
rows.zu: Imigqa eluhlaza iqukethe amarekhodi ama-kg angempela kuphela. Imigqa yegolide ihlanganisa ama-kg alindelwe. Okwangempela kungena esikhundleni sokulindelwe emthonjeni wokudla nasenyangeni efanayo. Lezi yizamba ezincane ezaziwayo; amanani angekho ezitshalo, izihlahla nezilwane awafakwa kuzo.
rows.st: Dibara tse tala di na le direkoto tsa kg tsa nnete feela. Dibara tsa kgauta di kenyelletsa kg tse lebelletsweng. Tsa nnete di nka sebaka sa tse lebelletsweng bakeng sa mohlodi wa dijo le kgwedi e tshwanang. Tsena ke dikakaretso tse nyane tse tsejwang; bongata bo siyo ba dijalo, difate le diphoofolo ha bo kenngwe ho tsona.
rows.ts: Tibara ta rihlaza ti na tirhekhodo ta kg ta xiviri ntsena. Tibara ta nsuku ti katsa kg leyi languteriweke. Ya xiviri yi siva leyi languteriweke eka xihlovo xa swakudya ni n’hweti yin’we. Leti i tinhlayo ta swiphemu leti tivekaka; tinhlayo leti kayivelaka ta swibyariwa, mirhi ni swifuwo a ti katsiwi eka tona.
rows.ve: Mabara madala a na rekhodo dza kg dza vhukuma fhedzi. Mabara a musuku a katela kg dzo lavhelelwaho. Dza vhukuma dzi dzhiela dzo lavhelelwaho vhudzulo kha tshiko tsha zwiḽiwa na ṅwedzi muthihi. Izwi ndi zwivhalo zwa zwipiḓa zwi ḓivheaho; zwivhalo zwi siho zwa zwiliṅwa, miri na zwifuwo a zwi katelwi khazwo.

rows.english: Monthly production kg are not recorded. The crop-cycle graph below is a planning benchmark; it does not fill in missing monthly harvest weights.
rows.zu: Ama-kg okukhiqiza enyanga awarekhodiwe. Ishadi lomjikelezo wesitshalo elingezansi liyisilinganiso sokuhlela; aligcwalisi izisindo zesivuno senyanga ezingekho.
rows.st: Kg tsa tlhahiso ya kgwedi ha di rekotwe. Tjhate ya potoloho ya sejalo e ka tlase ke tekanyo ya moralo; ha e tlatse boima ba kotulo ya kgwedi bo siyo.
rows.ts: Kg ta vuhumelerisi bya n’hweti a ti rhekhodiwanga. Chati ya ndzhendzheleko wa xibyariwa leyi nga ehansi i mpimo wo kunguhata; a yi tati mintiko ya ntshovelo wa n’hweti leyi kayivelaka.
rows.ve: Kg dza mveledzo ya ṅwedzi a dzo ngo rekhodiwa. Tshati ya mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa i re fhasi ndi tshikalo tsha u pulana; a i ḓadzi zwileme zwa khaṋo ya ṅwedzi zwi siho.

rows.english: Crop-cycle kg by first picking month
rows.zu: Ama-kg omjikelezo wesitshalo ngenyanga yokuqala yokuvuna
rows.st: Kg tsa potoloho ya sejalo ka kgwedi ya pele ya kotulo
rows.ts: Kg ta ndzhendzheleko wa xibyariwa hi n’hweti yo sungula yo tshovela
rows.ve: Kg dza mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa nga ṅwedzi wa u thoma wa u kaṋa

rows.english: full-cycle kg
rows.st: kg tsa potoloho e felletseng
rows.ts: kg ta ndzhendzheleko lowu heleleke
rows.ve: kg dza mutevhe wo fhelelaho

rows.english: Each bar groups the entire crop-cycle benchmark by the month picking starts. It is not the weight harvested in that month. The source does not supply a monthly picking curve; quantities are not divided across a picking window.
rows.zu: Umugqa ngamunye uhlanganisa sonke isilinganiso somjikelezo wesitshalo ngenyanga okuqala ngayo ukuvuna. Akusona isisindo esivunwa kuleyo nyanga. Umthombo awunikezi ijika lokuvuna lenyanga; amanani awahlukaniswa kulo lonke isikhathi sokuvuna.
rows.st: Bara ka nngwe e bokella tekanyo yohle ya potoloho ya sejalo ka kgwedi eo kotulo e qalang ka yona. Ha se boima bo kotulwang kgweding eo. Mohlodi ha o fane ka tjhate ya phallo ya kotulo ka kgwedi; bongata ha bo arolwe nakong ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Bara yin’wana ni yin’wana yi hlanganisa mpimo wa ndzhendzheleko hinkwawo wa xibyariwa hi n’hweti leyi ku tshovela ku sungulaka ha yona. A hi ntiko lowu tshoveriwaka eka n’hweti yoleyo. Xihlovo a xi nyiki ndzandzelelano wa ku tshovela hi n’hweti; tinhlayo a ti aviwi eka nkarhi wo tshovela.
rows.ve: Bara iṅwe na iṅwe i kuvhanganya tshikalo tshoṱhe tsha mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa nga ṅwedzi une u kaṋa ha thoma ngawo. A si tshileme tshine tsha kaṋiwa kha uyo ṅwedzi. Tshiko a tshi ṋei tshati ya u kaṋa nga ṅwedzi; zwivhalo a zwi kovhelwi kha tshifhinga tsha u kaṋa.

rows.english: No crop-cycle kg comparison is available for cycles starting harvest in this dated year. Check planting dates, growing space and sourced crop benchmarks.
rows.zu: Akukho kuqhathaniswa kwama-kg omjikelezo wesitshalo emijikelezweni eqala ukuvunwa kulo nyaka onezinsuku. Hlola izinsuku zokutshala, indawo yokutshala nezilinganiso zezitshalo ezivela emithonjeni.
rows.st: Ha ho papiso ya kg tsa potoloho ya sejalo e fumanehang bakeng sa medikoloho e qalang kotulo selemong sena se nang le matsatsi. Hlahloba matsatsi a ho lema, sebaka sa temo le ditekanyo tsa dijalo tse tswang mehloding.
rows.ts: A ku na ku fananisa ka kg ta ndzhendzheleko wa xibyariwa ka mindzhendzheleko leyi sungulaka ku tshovela eka lembe leri ri nga ni masiku. Kambela masiku yo byala, ndhawu yo byala ni mimpimo ya swibyariwa leyi humaka eswihlobyeni.
rows.ve: A hu na mbambedzo ya kg dza mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa ya mutevhe ine ya thoma u kaṋa kha uno ṅwaha u re na maḓuvha. Sedzulusani maḓuvha a u ṱavha, fhethu ha u lima na zwikalo zwa zwiliṅwa zwi bvaho kha zwiko.

rows.st: Bongata ba dijalo bo ka ntle ho kakaretso e nyane e tsejwang ya potoloho: {crops}.
rows.ts: Tinhlayo ta swibyariwa leti nga ehandle ka nhlayo ya xiphemu xa ndzhendzheleko leyi tivekaka: {crops}.
rows.ve: Zwivhalo zwa zwiliṅwa zwi re nnḓa ha tshivhalo tsha tshipiḓa tsha mutevhe tshi ḓivheaho: {crops}.

rows.english: No monthly quantities are recorded for this dated year in kg, eggs, litres, items or kept-stock kg. Enter expected or actual amounts in the app; the printed monthly table appears once a quantity is recorded, including zero.
rows.zu: Awekho amanani enyanga arekhodiwe kulo nyaka onezinsuku ngama-kg, amaqanda, amalitha, izinto noma ama-kg okudla okugciniwe. Faka amanani alindelwe noma angempela ohlelweni; ithebula lenyanga eliphrintiwe livela lapho sekurekhodiwe inani, kuhlanganise noziro.
rows.st: Ha ho bongata ba kgwedi bo rekotilweng selemong sena se nang le matsatsi ka kg, mahe, dilitara, dintho kapa kg tsa dijo tse bolokilweng. Kenya bongata bo lebelletsweng kapa ba nnete ho app; tafole e hatisitsweng ya kgwedi e hlaha ha bongata bo se bo rekotilwe, ho kenyeletswa noto.
rows.ts: A ku rhekhodiwanga tinhlayo ta n’hweti eka lembe leri ri nga ni masiku hi kg, matandza, tilitara, swilo kumbe kg ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke. Nghenisa tinhlayo leti languteriweke kumbe ta xiviri eka app; tafula ra n’hweti leri kandziyisiweke ri humelela loko ku rhekhodiwile nhlayo, ku katsa na ziro.
rows.ve: A hu na zwivhalo zwa ṅwedzi zwo rekhodiwaho kha uno ṅwaha u re na maḓuvha nga kg, makumba, ḽithara, zwithu kana kg dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho. Dzhenisani zwivhalo zwo lavhelelwaho kana zwa vhukuma kha app; thebuḽu yo gandiswaho ya ṅwedzi i bvelela musi tshivhalo tsho no rekhodiwa, hu tshi katelwa zero.

rows.english: ? means quantity not recorded, not zero. * marks a known stock subtotal with missing batch weights. Egg counts and litres use actual records where entered, otherwise expected records. They are never converted to kg. Stock kg are food already held; they are never added to new production.
rows.zu: ? kusho ukuthi inani alirekhodiwe, hhayi uziro. * imaka isamba esincane sokudla okugciniwe esaziwayo lapho izisindo zamanye amaqoqo zingekho. Izibalo zamaqanda namalitha zisebenzisa amarekhodi angempela lapho efakiwe, kungenjalo zisebenzisa alindelwe. Akuguqulwa kube ama-kg. Ama-kg okudla okugciniwe abonisa ukudla osekuvele kukhona; awangezwa ekukhiqizeni okusha.
rows.st: ? e bolela hore bongata ha bo rekotwe, eseng noto. * e tshwaya kakaretso e nyane e tsejwang ya dijo tse bolokilweng e nang le boima ba dihlopha bo siyo. Dipalo tsa mahe le dilitara di sebedisa direkoto tsa nnete moo di kentsweng, ho seng jwalo di sebedisa tse lebelletsweng. Ha di fetolelwe ho kg le ka mohla. Kg tsa dijo tse bolokilweng ke dijo tse seng di le teng; ha di eketswe tlhahisong e ntjha.
rows.ts: ? swi vula leswaku nhlayo a yi rhekhodiwanga, ku nga ri ziro. * yi fungha nhlayo ya xiphemu leyi tivekaka ya swakudya leswi hlayisiweke leyi kayivelaka mintiko ya swiphemu. Tinhlayo ta matandza ni tilitara ti tirhisa tirhekhodo ta xiviri laha ti nghenisiweke, loko swi nga ri tano ti tirhisa leti languteriweke. A ti hundzuluriwi ku va kg. Kg ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke i swakudya leswi se swi nga kona; a ti engeteriwi eka vuhumelerisi byintshwa.
rows.ve: ? i amba uri tshivhalo a tsho ngo rekhodiwa, hu si zero. * i swaya tshivhalo tsha tshipiḓa tshi ḓivheaho tsha zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho tshi re na zwileme zwa zwigwada zwi siho. Mbalo dza makumba na ḽithara dzi shumisa rekhodo dza vhukuma he dza dzheniswa hone, arali zwi si zwenezwo dzi shumisa dzo lavhelelwaho. A dzi shandulwi u vha kg. Kg dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho ndi zwiḽiwa zwi re hone kale; a dzi engedzwi kha mveledzo ntswa.

rows.ts: Tinhlayo ta n’hweti ta ha laveka: {sources}. Swikombo swa ndzavisiso swa tinguva a swi tiyisisi ntiko wa ntshovelo.

rows.ve: Zwiko zwa zwiḽiwa zwi si na tshivhalo tshi re na ḓuvha: {sources}.

rows.st: Dijo tse bolokilweng tse se nang kg tsa poloko tse rekotilweng: {sources}. Dinako tsa poloko tsa khathaloko le dikgwedi tsa ho boloka ha di fane ka boima ba dijo tse bolokilweng.
rows.ts: Swakudya leswi hlayisiweke leswi nga riki na kg ta vuhlayiselo leti rhekhodiweke: {sources}. Minkarhi ya vuhlayiselo ya khathalogu ni tin’hweti to hlayisa a swi nyiki ntiko wa swakudya leswi hlayisiweke.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho zwi si na kg dzo rekhodiwaho: {sources}. Zwifhinga zwa u vhulunga zwa khathaḽogo na miṅwedzi ya u vhulunga a zwi ṋei tshileme tsha zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho.

rows.zu: Ama-kg ezihlahla ngokobudala ayizilinganiso ezicatshangiwe zepulazi zonyaka. Aboniswa emakhasini esivuno esizayo futhi awahlukaniswa emigqeni yokukhiqiza yenyanga.
rows.st: Kg tsa difate ka dilemo ke dikakanyo tsa polasi tsa selemo. Di bontshwa maqepheng a kotulo ya kamoso mme ha di arolwe dibareng tsa tlhahiso ya kgwedi.
rows.ts: Kg ta mirhi hi vukhale i mimpimo leyi ringanyetiweke ya purasi ya lembe. Ti kombisiwa eka matluka ya ntshovelo wa nkarhi lowu taka naswona a ti aviwi eka tibara ta vuhumelerisi bya n’hweti.
rows.ve: Kg dza miri nga miṅwaha ndi nyanganyelo dza bulasi dza ṅwaha. Dzi sumbedzwa kha masiaṱari a khaṋo ya tshifhinga tshi ḓaho nahone a dzi kovhelwi kha mabara a mveledzo ya ṅwedzi.

rows.english: Vegetables and staples alongside fruit, nuts and berries. Ten-year projection; not a harvest promise.
rows.zu: Imifino nokudla okuyisisekelo kanye nezithelo, amantongomane namabheri. Isilinganiso seminyaka eyishumi; akusona isithembiso sesivuno.
rows.st: Meroho le dijalo tsa motheo hammoho le ditholwana, linate le monokotshwai. Ponelopele ya dilemo tse leshome; ha se tshepiso ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka swin’we ni mihandzu, timanga ni mabyerisi. Mvhumbo wa khume ra malembe; a hi xitshembiso xa ntshovelo.
rows.ve: Miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo khathihi na mitshelo, nḓuhu na maberi. Mbonelaphanḓa ya miṅwaha ya fumi; a si fulufhedziso ḽa khaṋo.

rows.english: Green = vegetable and staple crop cycles. Gold = your tree yield schedule. Striped ends show harvest that changes as plants age during the year. * = known subtotal only; missing yields are not zero.
rows.zu: Okuluhlaza = imijikelezo yemifino nokudla okuyisisekelo. Okusagolide = uhlelo lwakho lwesivuno sezihlahla. Iziphetho ezinemithende zibonisa isivuno esishintshayo njengoba izitshalo zikhula phakathi nonyaka. * = isamba esincane esaziwayo kuphela; izivuno ezingekho aziwona uziro.
rows.st: Botala = medikoloho ya meroho le dijalo tsa motheo. Mmala wa kgauta = lenane la hao la kotulo ya difate. Dipheletso tse metsero di bontsha kotulo e fetohang ha dimela di hola selemong. * = kakaretso e tsejwang feela; dikotulo tse siyo ha se lefela.
rows.ts: Rihlaza = mindzhendzheleko ya matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka. Nsuku = nongonoko wa wena wa ntshovelo wa mirhi. Makumu lama nga ni tilayini ma komba ntshovelo lowu cincaka loko swimila swi kula elembeni. * = nhlayo leyitsongo leyi tivekaka ntsena; mintshovelo leyi kayivelaka a hi ziro.
rows.ve: Mudala = mutevhe ya miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo. Musuku = mbekanyamushumo yaṋu ya khaṋo ya miri. Magumo a re na mitalo a sumbedza khaṋo ine ya shanduka musi zwimela zwi tshi aluwa kha ṅwaha. * = tshivhalo tshiṱuku tshi ḓivheaho fhedzi; khaṋo dzi siho a si zero.

rows.english: Projection, not a harvest promise. Vegetables and staples repeat only saved recurring sowings; dated and existing crops happen once.
rows.zu: Isilinganiso, hhayi isithembiso sesivuno. Imifino nokudla okuyisisekelo kuphinda kuphela ukuhlwanyela okuphindwayo okugcinwe ohlelweni; izitshalo ezinezinsuku nezikhona zenzeka kanye.
rows.st: Ponelopele, eseng tshepiso ya kotulo. Meroho le dijalo tsa motheo di pheta feela ho jala ho iphetang ho bolokilweng; dijalo tse nang le matsatsi le tse seng di le teng di etsahala hang feela.
rows.ts: Mvhumbo, ku nga ri xitshembiso xa ntshovelo. Matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka swi phinda ntsena ku byala loku phindhaka loku hlayisiweke; swibyariwa leswi nga ni masiku ni leswi nga kona swi humelela kan’we ntsena.
rows.ve: Mbonelaphanḓa, hu si fulufhedziso ḽa khaṋo. Miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo zwi dovholola u zwala hu dovhololaho ho vhulungwaho fhedzi; zwiliṅwa zwi re na maḓuvha na zwi re hone zwi itea luthihi.

rows.english: Vegetable and staple crop-cycle kilograms are counted in the year of first picking, not divided into monthly quantities. Carry-in harvests need actual records.
rows.zu: Amakhilogremu omjikelezo wemifino nokudla okuyisisekelo abalwa ngonyaka wokuqala wokuvuna, awahlukaniswa abe amanani enyanga. Izivuno eziqale ngaphambi konyaka zidinga amarekhodi angempela.
rows.st: Dikhilograma tsa potoloho ya meroho le dijalo tsa motheo di balwa selemong sa ho qala kotulo, ha di arolwe ka bongata ba dikgwedi. Dikotulo tse qalileng pele ho selemo di hloka direkoto tsa nnete.
rows.ts: Tikhilogiramu ta ndzhendzheleko wa matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka ti hlayiwa elembeni ro sungula ku tshovela, a ti avanyisiwi hi tinhlayo ta tin’hweti. Mintshovelo leyi sunguleke lembe ri nga si fika yi lava tirhekhodo ta xiviri.
rows.ve: Khilogiramu dza mutevhe wa miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo dzi vhalwa kha ṅwaha wa u thoma u kaṋa, a dzi kovhekanywi nga zwivhalo zwa miṅwedzi. Khaṋo dzo thomaho ṅwaha u sa athu u thoma dzi ṱoḓa rekhodo dza vhukuma.

rows.english: Vegetable and staple estimates hold bed area, sowings and crop benchmarks constant. Revise the plan if growing trees change shade, water or available bed space.
rows.zu: Izilinganiso zemifino nokudla okuyisisekelo zigcina indawo yombhede, ukuhlwanyela namazinga okuqhathanisa ezitshalo kungashintshi. Buyekeza uhlelo uma izihlahla ezikhulayo zishintsha umthunzi, amanzi noma indawo yombhede etholakalayo.
rows.st: Dikakanyo tsa meroho le dijalo tsa motheo di boloka sebaka sa bethe, ho jala le ditekanyetso tsa dijalo di sa fetohe. Fetola moralo haeba difate tse holang di fetola moriti, metsi kapa sebaka sa bethe se teng.
rows.ts: Swiringanyeto swa matsavu ni swibyariwa swa nkoka swi hlayisa ndhawu ya mubedo, ku byala ni mimpimo ya swibyariwa swi nga cinci. Pfuxeta kungu loko mirhi leyi kulaka yi cinca ndzhuti, mati kumbe ndhawu ya mubedo leyi kumekaka.
rows.ve: Ndumbedzo dza miroho na zwiliṅwa zwa mutheo dzi vhulunga fhethu ha mubete, u zwala na mimpimo ya zwiliṅwa zwi sa shanduki. Vusuludzani pulane arali miri i aluwaho ya shandula murunzi, maḓi kana fhethu ha mubete hu re hone.

rows.english: Tree ages run from planting on this site. Separate older and younger plants into age groups. Research first-crop ages are references, not guaranteed dates.
rows.zu: Iminyaka yezihlahla iqala lapho zitshalwa kule ndawo. Hlukanisa izitshalo ezindala nezincane ngamaqembu eminyaka. Iminyaka yesivuno sokuqala yocwaningo iyizinkomba, hhayi izinsuku eziqinisekisiwe.
rows.st: Dilemo tsa difate di qala ha di lengwa sebakeng sena. Arola dimela tse kgolo le tse nyane ka dihlopha tsa dilemo. Dilemo tsa kotulo ya pele tsa dipatlisiso ke ditshupiso, eseng matsatsi a tiisitsweng.
rows.ts: Malembe ya mirhi ma sungula loko yi byariwa endhawini leyi. Avanyisa swimila swa khale ni leswintshwa hi mintlawa ya vukhale. Malembe ya ntshovelo wo sungula ya ndzavisiso i swisekelo, ku nga ri masiku lama tiyisisiweke.
rows.ve: Miṅwaha ya miri i thoma musi i tshi ṱavhiwa kha fhethu afha. Fhandekanyani zwimela zwihulwane na zwiṱuku nga zwigwada zwa miṅwaha. Miṅwaha ya khaṋo ya u thoma ya ṱhoḓisiso ndi zwisumbedzi, hu si maḓuvha o khwaṱhisedzwaho.

rows.english: Tree kg are your farm or nursery assumptions per plant per year. Values hold until the next age you enter; no growth multiplier is invented. A range covers changes within the year. Review the schedule as plants age.
rows.zu: Ama-kg ezihlahla ayizilinganiso zepulazi lakho noma zenkulisa ngesitshalo ngonyaka. Amanani ahlala enjalo kuze kufike iminyaka elandelayo oyifakayo; akukho siphindaphindi sokukhula esisunguliwe. Ibanga lihlanganisa ushintsho phakathi nonyaka. Buyekeza uhlelo njengoba izitshalo zikhula.
rows.st: Kg tsa difate ke dikakanyo tsa polasi ya hao kapa tsa sebaka sa ho hodisa dimela ka semela ka selemo. Ditekanyo di dula jwalo ho fihlela dilemong tse latelang tseo o di kenyang; ha ho qapwe tekanyo e atisang kgolo. Moedi o akaretsa diphetoho selemong. Hlahloba lenane ha dimela di hola.
rows.ts: Kg ta mirhi i swiringanyeto swa purasi ra wena kumbe ndhawu yo kurisa swimila hi ximilana hi lembe. Mimpimo yi tshamisa xisweswo ku fika eka vukhale byin’wana u byi nghenisaka; a ku tumbuluxiwi mpimo wo andzisa ku kula. Mpimo wo suka eka wun’wana ku ya eka wun’wana wu katsa ku cinca endzeni ka lembe. Kambisisa nongonoko loko swimila swi kula.
rows.ve: Kg dza miri ndi ndumbedzo dza bulasi ḽaṋu kana dza fhethu ha u alusa zwimela nga tshimela nga ṅwaha. Mimpimo i dzula yo ralo u swika kha miṅwaha i tevhelaho ine na i dzhenisa; a hu vhumbiwi mpimo wa u andisa nyaluwo. Mukano u katela tshanduko dza kha ṅwaha. Sedzulusani mbekanyamushumo musi zwimela zwi tshi aluwa.

rows.english: Check that the variety, local climate, pollination, water and care match your yield assumptions. Ages alone do not establish site suitability or survival.
rows.zu: Hlola ukuthi uhlobo, isimo sezulu sendawo, impova, amanzi nokunakekela kuhambisana nezilinganiso zakho zesivuno. Iminyaka iyodwa ayiqinisekisi ukufaneleka kwendawo noma ukusinda.
rows.st: Hlahloba hore mofuta, tlelaemete ya sebaka, ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya palesa, metsi le tlhokomelo di dumellana le dikakanyo tsa hao tsa kotulo. Dilemo feela ha di tiise ho tshwaneleha ha sebaka kapa ho phela ha dimela.
rows.ts: Kambela leswaku muxaka, maxelo ya ndhawu, ku hangalasiwa ka mpova, mati ni nhlayiso swi fambelana ni swiringanyeto swa wena swa ntshovelo. Vukhale ntsena a byi tiyisisi ku faneleka ka ndhawu kumbe ku hanya.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani uri lushaka, kilima ya henefho, u phaḓaladza luvhanda, maḓi na ṱhogomelo zwi anḓana na ndumbedzo dzaṋu dza khaṋo. Miṅwaha fhedzi a i khwaṱhisedzi u tea ha fhethu kana u tshila.

rows.english: Known subtotals leave out missing yields. Eggs, meat, milk, fish and honey are not included in these crop kg totals. Picking months and food-gap checks still need local confirmation.
rows.zu: Izamba ezincane ezaziwayo zishiya ngaphandle izivuno ezingekho. Amaqanda, inyama, ubisi, izinhlanzi noju akufakwa kulezi zamba zama-kg ezitshalo. Izinyanga zokuvuna nokuhlola izikhala zokudla kusadinga ukuqinisekiswa endaweni.
rows.st: Dikakaretso tse tsejwang di siya dikotulo tse siyo kantle. Mahe, nama, lebese, ditlhapi le mahe a dinotshi ha di kenyeletswe dikakaretsong tsena tsa kg tsa dijalo. Dikgwedi tsa kotulo le ditlhahlobo tsa dikgeo tsa dijo di sa hloka netefatso sebakeng seo.
rows.ts: Tinhlayo letitsongo leti tivekaka a ti katsi mintshovelo leyi kayivelaka. Matandza, nyama, ntswamba, tihlampfi ni vulombe a swi katsiwanga eka tinhlayo leti ta kg ta swibyariwa. Tin’hweti ta ntshovelo ni ku kambela mavangwa ya swakudya swa ha lava ku tiyisisiwa endhawini.
rows.ve: Zwivhalo zwiṱuku zwi ḓivheaho a zwi kateli khaṋo dzi siho. Makumba, ṋama, mafhi, khovhe na mutoli a zwi katelwi kha zwivhalo izwi zwa kg dza zwiliṅwa. Miṅwedzi ya u kaṋa na u ṱola zwikhala zwa zwiḽiwa zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa khwaṱhisedzo ya henefho.

rows.st: Kholomo ka nngwe e akaretsa dikgwedi tse leshome le metso e mmedi. Kakaretso ya mofuta = dimela tsohle tse mmapeng. Mela ya dihlopha e fana ka kg tsa sehlopha seo sa dilemo. ? = tlhahisoleseding e siyo.
rows.ts: Kholomu yin’wana ni yin’wana yi katsa tin’hweti ta khume na timbirhi. Nhlayo ya muxaka = swimila hinkwato swa le mepeni. Tilayini ta mintlawa ti nyika kg ta ntlawa wolowo wa vukhale. ? = vuxokoxoko byo kayivela.
rows.ve: Kholomu iṅwe na iṅwe i katela miṅwedzi ya fumi-mbili. Tshivhalo tsha lushaka = zwimela zwoṱhe zwi re kha mapa. Mitalo ya zwigwada i ṋea kg dza tshigwada tshenetsho tsha miṅwaha. ? = mafhungo a siho.

rows.english: These are options to discuss, not a final breed recommendation. Confirm healthy stock, supplier availability, ventilation, chick warmth and a health plan locally. Record actual production months separately; this guide promises no output or dates.
rows.zu: Lezi yizinketho zokuxoxa ngazo, hhayi isincomo sokugcina sohlobo. Qinisekisa izinyoni eziphilile, ukutholakala kumhlinzeki, ukungena komoya, ukufudumala kwamachwane nohlelo lwezempilo endaweni. Rekhoda izinyanga zokukhiqiza zangempela ngokwehlukana; lo mhlahlandlela awuthembisi umkhiqizo noma izinsuku.
rows.st: Tsena ke dikgetho tsa ho buisana, eseng keletso ya ho qetela ya mofuta. Netefatsa dinonyana tse phetseng hantle, ho fumaneha ho mofani, moya o kenang, mofuthu wa ditsuonyana le moralo wa bophelo sebakeng seo. Rekota dikgwedi tsa tlhahiso ya nnete ka thoko; tataiso ena ha e tshepise tlhahiso kapa matsatsi.
rows.ts: Leswi i swihlawuriwa swo burisana, ku nga ri xitsundzuxo xo hetelela xa muxaka. Tiyisisa tihuku leti hanyeke kahle, ku kumeka eka muphakeri, moya lowu nghenaka, ku kufumela ka swikukwana ni kungu ra rihanyo endhawini. Rhekhoda tin’hweti ta vuhumelerisi bya xiviri hi ku hambana; xiletelo lexi a xi tshembisi vuhumelerisi kumbe masiku.
rows.ve: Izwi ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa u itela u haseledza, hu si nyeletshedzo ya u fhedzisela ya lushaka. Khwaṱhisedzani khuhu dzi re na mutakalo, u wanala kha muṋetshedzi, mufhe, mufhiso wa zwikukwana na pulane ya mutakalo henefho. Rekhodani miṅwedzi ya mveledzo ya vhukuma nga thungo; nyeletshedzo iyi a i fulufhedzisi mveledzo kana maḓuvha.

rows.ve: Naa maḓi o kunaho a u nwa a dzula a tshi wanala?

rows.english: Every breed needs clean drinking water, suitable feed and protected housing.
rows.zu: Lonke uhlobo ludinga amanzi ahlanzekile okuphuza, ukudla okufanele nendawo yokuhlala evikelekile.
rows.st: Mofuta o mong le o mong o hloka metsi a hlwekileng a ho nwa, dijo tse loketseng le matlo a sireleditsweng.
rows.ts: Muxaka wun’wana ni wun’wana wu lava mati yo nwa lama baseke, swakudya leswi faneleke ni tindlu leti sirhelelekeke.
rows.ve: Lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe lu ṱoḓa maḓi o kunaho a u nwa, zwiḽiwa zwo teaho na nnḓu dzo tsireledzeaho.

rows.english: Foraging alone may not supply enough nutrients for eggs.
rows.zu: Ukuzifunela ukudla kukodwa kungase kunganikezi izakhamzimba ezanele zamaqanda.
rows.st: Ho ipatlela dijo feela ho ka nna ha se fane ka dimatlafatsi tse lekaneng bakeng sa mahe.
rows.ts: Ku tihlotela swakudya ntsena swi nga ha nga nyiki swakudya swo aka miri leswi eneleke swa matandza.
rows.ve: U ḓiṱoḓela zwiḽiwa fhedzi zwi nga kha ḓi sa ṋea pfushi yo eḓanaho ya makumba.

rows.english: Growing water is limited. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm a safe poultry supply.
rows.zu: Amanzi okulima alinganiselwe. Hlola amanzi okuphuza ngokwehlukana; amanzi engadi awaqinisekisi amanzi aphephile ezinkukhu.
rows.st: Metsi a temo a haella. Hlahloba metsi a ho nwa ka thoko; metsi a serapeng ha a netefatse phepelo e bolokehileng bakeng sa dikgoho.
rows.ts: Mati yo byala ma kayivela. Kambela mati yo nwa hi ku hambana; mati ya ntanga a ma tiyisisi mphakelo lowu hlayisekeke wa tihuku.
rows.ve: Maḓi a u lima a kha ḓi vha maṱuku. Sedzulusani maḓi a u nwa nga thungo; maḓi a ngade a ha khwaṱhisedzi nḓisedzo yo tsireledzeaho ya khuhu.

rows.english: You reported wet ground. Check that chicken housing drains and bedding stays dry.
rows.zu: Ubike umhlabathi omanzi. Hlola ukuthi amanzi ayaphuma ezindlini zezinkukhu nezinto zokulala zihlala zomile.
rows.st: O tlalehile mobu o metsi. Hlahloba hore metsi a tswa matlong a dikgoho le hore bolao bo dula bo omme.
rows.ts: U vike misava leyi tsakamaka. Kambela leswaku mati ma huma etindlwini ta tihuku ni leswaku swo andlalela swi tshamisa swi omile.
rows.ve: No vhiga mavu a re na maḓi. Sedzulusani uri maḓi a bve nnḓuni dza khuhu na uri zwa u lala zwi dzule zwo oma.

rows.english: You reported frost. Check winter shelter and chick warmth with a local adviser.
rows.zu: Ubike isithwathwa. Hlola indawo yokukhosela ebusika nokufudumala kwamachwane nomeluleki wendawo.
rows.st: O tlalehile serame. Hlahloba tshireletso ya mariha le mofuthu wa ditsuonyana le moeletsi wa sebaka seo.
rows.ts: U vike gwitsi. Kambela vutumbelo bya xixika ni ku kufumela ka swikukwana ni mutsundzuxi wa ndhawu.
rows.ve: No vhiga murotholo. Sedzulusani vhudzumbamo ha vhuria na mufhiso wa zwikukwana na muṋeletshedzi wa henefho.

rows.english: In hot weather, provide shade, airflow and reliable water. This is general care advice; heat at this site has not been confirmed.
rows.zu: Uma kushisa, nikeza umthunzi, ukungena komoya namanzi athembekile. Lezi yizeluleko zokunakekela ezijwayelekile; ukushisa kule ndawo akuqinisekisiwe.
rows.st: Ha ho tjhesa, fana ka moriti, moya o phallang le metsi a tshepahalang. Ena ke keletso ya tlhokomelo ka kakaretso; motjheso sebakeng sena ha o eso netefatswe.
rows.ts: Loko ku hisa, nyika ndzhuti, moya lowu fambaka ni mati lama tiyisekeke. Lexi i xitsundzuxo xa nhlayiso hi ku angarhela; ku hisa endhawini leyi a ku si tiyisisiwa.
rows.ve: Musi hu tshi fhisa, ṋeani murunzi, mufhe u tshimbilaho na maḓi a fulufhedzeaho. Iyi ndi nyeletshedzo ya ṱhogomelo nga u angaredza; u fhisa ha fhethu afha a hu athu u khwaṱhisedzwa.

rows.english: Local chicken adaptation varies within provinces. Location alone does not identify the best breed for this farm.
rows.zu: Ukufaneleka kwezinkukhu zendawo kuyahlukahluka ngaphakathi kwezifundazwe. Indawo iyodwa ayibonisi uhlobo olungcono kakhulu lwaleli pulazi.
rows.st: Ho ikamahanya ha dikgoho tsa lehae ho fapana ka hare ho diprofinse. Sebaka feela ha se bontshe mofuta o motle ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa polasi ena.
rows.ts: Ku tolovela ka tihuku ta le kaya ku hambana endzeni ka swifundzhankulu. Ndhawu ntsena a yi kombi muxaka lowu faneleke ngopfu purasi leri.
rows.ve: U ḓowelana ha khuhu dza hayani na fhethu zwi a fhambana ngomu ha mavunḓu. Fhethu fhedzi a hu sumbedzi lushaka lwa khwine lwa bulasi iḽi.

rows.english: An egg-and-meat option. It outperformed the other indigenous breeds for eggs in a managed ARC trial; those results do not predict this farm.
rows.zu: Inketho yamaqanda nenyama. Yaveza amaqanda amaningi kunezinye izinhlobo zomdabu ocwaningweni lwe-ARC olwalulawulwa; leyo miphumela ayibikezeli leli pulazi.
rows.st: Kgetho ya mahe le nama. E hlahisitse mahe a mangata ho feta mefuta e meng ya lehae tekong e laolwang ya ARC; diphetho tseo ha di bolele se tla etsahala polasing ena.
rows.ts: Xihlawuriwa xa matandza ni nyama. Yi humesile matandza yo tala ku hundza tinxaka tin’wana ta ndzhavuko eka ndzingo lowu lawuriweke wa ARC; mimbuyelo yoleyo a yi vhumbi purasi leri.
rows.ve: Ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa zwa makumba na ṋama. Yo bveledza makumba manzhi u fhira dziṅwe tshaka dza hayani kha ndingo yo langwaho ya ARC; mvelelo idzo a dzi vhumbi bulasi iḽi.

rows.english: An ARC-conserved indigenous option for eggs and meat; check local stock and care needs.
rows.zu: Inketho yomdabu egcinwe yi-ARC yamaqanda nenyama; hlola izinyoni ezitholakala endaweni nezidingo zokunakekela.
rows.st: Kgetho ya lehae e bolokilweng ke ARC bakeng sa mahe le nama; hlahloba dinonyana tsa sebaka seo le ditlhoko tsa tlhokomelo.
rows.ts: Xihlawuriwa xa ndzhavuko lexi hlayisiweke hi ARC xa matandza ni nyama; kambela tihuku ta le ndhawini ni swilaveko swa nhlayiso.
rows.ve: Ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa zwa hayani zwo vhulungwaho nga ARC zwa makumba na ṋama; sedzulusani khuhu dza henefho na ṱhoḓea dza ṱhogomelo.

rows.english: An indigenous option described across diverse South African climates; confirm suitability with local advice.
rows.zu: Inketho yomdabu echazwe ezimweni zezulu ezahlukene zaseNingizimu Afrika; qinisekisa ukufaneleka ngezeluleko zendawo.
rows.st: Kgetho ya lehae e hlalositsweng maemong a tlelaemete a fapaneng a Afrika Borwa; netefatsa ho tshwaneleha ka keletso ya sebaka seo.
rows.ts: Xihlawuriwa xa ndzhavuko lexi hlamuseriweke eka maxelo yo hambana ya Afrika-Dzonga; tiyisisa ku faneleka hi switsundzuxo swa ndhawu.
rows.ve: Ndi zwine zwa nga nangwa zwa hayani zwo ṱaluswaho kha kilima dzo fhambanaho dza Afurika Tshipembe; khwaṱhisedzani u tea hazwo nga nyeletshedzo ya henefho.

rows.english: Consider only after checking reliable feed, drinking water, housing, health care and managed lighting. Breed and supplier still need local confirmation.
rows.zu: Cabanga ngale nketho kuphela emva kokuhlola ukudla okuthembekile, amanzi okuphuza, izindlu, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo nokukhanyisa okulawulwayo. Uhlobo nomhlinzeki kusadinga ukuqinisekiswa endaweni.
rows.st: Nahana ka yona feela ka mora ho hlahloba dijo tse tshepahalang, metsi a ho nwa, matlo, tlhokomelo ya bophelo le mabone a laolwang. Mofuta le mofani di sa hloka netefatso sebakeng seo.
rows.ts: Yi tekeleni enhlokweni ntsena endzhaku ko kambela swakudya leswi tiyisekeke, mati yo nwa, tindlu, nhlayiso wa rihanyo ni mavoni lama lawuriwaka. Muxaka ni muphakeri swa ha lava ku tiyisisiwa endhawini.
rows.ve: Dzi dzhieleni nṱha fhedzi nga murahu ha u sedzulusa zwiḽiwa zwi fulufhedzeaho, maḓi a u nwa, nnḓu, ṱhogomelo ya mutakalo na mavhone a langwaho. Lushaka na muṋetshedzi zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa khwaṱhisedzo ya henefho.

rows.english: Needs dependable balanced feed, water, suitable housing and management. Confirm chick supply and a meat outlet before choosing.
rows.zu: Idinga ukudla okunomsoco olinganiselwe okuthembekile, amanzi, izindlu ezifanele nokuphathwa. Qinisekisa ukutholakala kwamachwane nendawo yokudayisa inyama ngaphambi kokukhetha.
rows.st: E hloka dijo tse leka-lekaneng tse tshepahalang, metsi, matlo a loketseng le tsamaiso. Netefatsa phepelo ya ditsuonyana le sebaka sa ho rekisa nama pele o kgetha.
rows.ts: Yi lava swakudya leswi ringaniseriweke leswi tiyisekeke, mati, tindlu leti faneleke ni vulawuri. Tiyisisa mphakelo wa swikukwana ni ndhawu yo xavisa nyama u nga si hlawula.
rows.ve: Zwi ṱoḓa zwiḽiwa zwa pfushi yo linganelaho zwi fulufhedzeaho, maḓi, nnḓu dzo teaho na ndangulo. Khwaṱhisedzani nḓisedzo ya zwikukwana na fhethu ha u rengisa ṋama musi ni sa athu u nanga.

rows.english: Commercial layers — egg system
rows.st: Dikgoho tsa mahe tsa kgwebo — mokgwa wa mahe
rows.ts: Tihuku ta matandza ta bindzu — endlelo ra matandza
rows.ve: Khuhu dza makumba dza mabindu — maitele a makumba

rows.english: Commercial broilers — meat system
rows.st: Dikgoho tsa nama tsa kgwebo — mokgwa wa nama
rows.ts: Tihuku ta nyama ta bindzu — endlelo ra nyama
rows.ve: Khuhu dza ṋama dza mabindu — maitele a ṋama

rows.english: Care needs attention before expansion
rows.st: Tlhokomelo e hloka ho shejwa pele ho katoloso
rows.ts: Nhlayiso wu lava ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ku nga si andzisiwa
rows.ve: Ṱhogomelo i ṱoḓa u sedzuluswa hu sa athu u engedzwa

rows.english: Improve night protection and weatherproof housing.
rows.zu: Thuthukisa ukuvikeleka kwasebusuku nezindlu ezivikela isimo sezulu.
rows.st: Ntlafatsa tshireletso ya bosiu le matlo a sireletsang kgahlanong le maemo a lehodimo.
rows.ts: Antswisa nsirhelelo wa nivusiku ni tindlu leti sirhelelaka eka maxelo.
rows.ve: Khwinifhadzani tsireledzo ya vhusiku na nnḓu dzi tsireledzaho kha mutsho.

rows.english: Check feed suitability; scavenging and scraps may not meet laying hens’ needs.
rows.zu: Hlola ukufaneleka kokudla; ukuzifunela ukudla nezinsalela kungase kungahlangabezani nezidingo zezikhukhukazi ezizalelayo.
rows.st: Hlahloba ho tshwaneleha ha dijo; ho ipatlela dijo le masalla ho ka nna ha se kgotsofatse ditlhoko tsa dikgoho tse behelang.
rows.ts: Kambela ku faneleka ka swakudya; ku tihlotela swakudya ni masalela swi nga ha nga enerisi swilaveko swa tihuku leti tshikelaka.
rows.ve: Sedzulusani u tea ha zwiḽiwa; u ḓiṱoḓela zwiḽiwa na masalela zwi nga kha ḓi sa swikelela ṱhoḓea dza khuhu dzi khou kudzelaho.

rows.english: Secure reliable clean drinking water before buying more birds.
rows.zu: Qinisekisa amanzi okuphuza ahlanzekile nathembekile ngaphambi kokuthenga izinyoni ezengeziwe.
rows.st: Fumana metsi a hlwekileng a ho nwa a tshepahalang pele o reka dinonyana tse ding.
rows.ts: Tiyisisa mati yo nwa lama baseke lama tiyisekeke u nga si xava tihuku tin’wana.
rows.ve: Khwaṱhisedzani maḓi o kunaho a u nwa a fulufhedzeaho musi ni sa athu u renga khuhu dziṅwe.

rows.english: Discuss these choices with a local adviser
rows.st: Buisana ka dikgetho tsena le moeletsi wa sebaka seo
rows.ts: Burisanani hi swihlawuriwa leswi ni mutsundzuxi wa ndhawu
rows.ve: Haseledzani zwine na nga nanga izwi na muṋeletshedzi wa henefho

rows.english: Your selected chicken enterprise and recorded purpose differ; review them together.
rows.zu: Uhlelo lwezinkukhu olukhethile nenjongo oyirekhodile kuyahluka; kubuyekeze ndawonye.
rows.st: Kgwebo ya dikgoho eo o e kgethileng le morero o rekotilweng di a fapana; di hlahlobe hammoho.
rows.ts: Bindzu ra tihuku leri u ri hlawuleke ni xikongomelo lexi rhekhodiweke swa hambana; swi kambisise swin’we.
rows.ve: Bindu ḽa khuhu ḽe na nanga na ndivho yo rekhodiwaho zwi a fhambana; zwi sedzuluseni zwoṱhe.

rows.ts: Xana ndhawu leyi yi kuma gwitsi?
rows.ve: Naa fhethu afha hu vha na murotholo?

rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya mveledzo

rows.ve: Musi ni sa athu u renga kana u thoma

rows.english: Use your farm observations and the research shortlists. Confirm choices locally before buying.
rows.zu: Sebenzisa lokho okubonile epulazini nohlu olufushane locwaningo. Qinisekisa izinketho endaweni ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Sebedisa seo o se boneng polasing le manane a makgutshwane a dipatlisiso. Netefatsa dikgetho sebakeng seo pele o reka.
rows.ts: Tirhisa leswi u swi voneke epurasini ni minxaxamelo yo koma ya ndzavisiso. Tiyisisa swihlawuriwa endhawini u nga si xava.
rows.ve: Shumisani zwe na zwi vhona bulasini na mitevhe mipfufhi ya ṱhoḓisiso. Khwaṱhisedzani zwine na nanga henefho musi ni sa athu u renga.

rows.ve: Rekhodo dza ṅwaha wa u vhiga - hu si mbonelaphanḓa

rows.zu: Izamba nezinyanga zonyaka wokubika odlule zichaza lokho okwabikwa. Azithembisi ukudla ohlelweni oluzayo.
rows.st: Dikakaretso le dikgwedi tsa selemo sa tlaleho se fetileng di hlalosa se tlalehilweng. Ha di tshepise dijo moralong o tlang.
rows.ts: Tinhlayo ni tin’hweti ta lembe leri hundzeke ro vika swi hlamusela leswi vikiweke. A swi tshembisi swakudya eka kungu leri taka.
rows.ve: Zwivhalo na miṅwedzi zwa ṅwaha wo fhiraho wa u vhiga zwi ṱalutshedza zwo vhigwaho. A zwi fulufhedzisi zwiḽiwa kha pulane i ḓaho.

rows.st: Boloka lebitso la mofuta oo o o kgethang ka nnete. Manane a makgutshwane a dipatlisiso a hloka netefatso bakeng sa nako ya sebaka, metsi le mobu.
rows.ts: Hlayisa vito ra muxaka lowu u wu hlawulaka hakunene. Minxaxamelo yo koma ya ndzavisiso yi lava ku tiyisisiwa eka nguva ya ndhawu, mati ni misava.
rows.ve: Vhulungani dzina ḽa lushaka lune na nanga zwa vhukuma. Mitevhe mipfufhi ya ṱhoḓisiso i ṱoḓa khwaṱhisedzo ya khalaṅwaha ya henefho, maḓi na mavu.

rows.english: Farmer reports reliable growing water. Confirm that the supply can carry each planned crop cycle.
rows.zu: Umlimi ubika amanzi okutshalela athembekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi amanzi anele umjikelezo ngamunye wezitshalo ohleliwe.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha metsi a tshepahalang a ho lema. Netefatsa hore phepelo e ka lekana potoloho ka nngwe e rerilweng ya dijalo.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika mati yo byala lama kumekaka nkarhi ni nkarhi. Tiyisisa leswaku mphakelo wu nga enerisa ndzhendzeleko wun’wana ni wun’wana wa swibyariwa lowu kunguhatiweke.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga maḓi a u lima a fulufhedzeaho. Khwaṱhisedzani uri mphakelo u nga kona mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe wa zwiliṅwa wo pulanwaho.

rows.english: Farmer reports limited growing water. Confirm which beds can be watered before buying planting material.
rows.zu: Umlimi ubika amanzi okutshalela alinganiselwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi yimiphi imibhede enganiselwa ngaphambi kokuthenga okokutshala.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha metsi a fokolang a ho lema. Netefatsa hore ke dibethe dife tse ka nosetswang pele o reka dintho tsa ho jala.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika mati matsongo yo byala. Tiyisisa leswaku i mibedo yihi leyi nga cheletiwaka u nga si xava swilo swo byala.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga maḓi a u lima a songo eḓanaho. Khwaṱhisedzani uri ndi mimbete ifhio ine ya nga sheledzwa ni sa athu u renga zwishumiswa zwa u ṱavha.

rows.english: Farmer reports rain-only growing. Use this site's rain-fed crop checks; water for animals is a separate need.
rows.zu: Umlimi ubika ukuthi ukutshala kuncike emvuleni kuphela. Sebenzisa ukuhlolwa kwezitshalo ezincike emvuleni kwale ndawo; amanzi ezilwane ayisidingo esihlukile.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha temo e itshetlehileng ka pula feela. Sebedisa ditlhahlobo tsa dijalo tsa sebaka sena tse nosetswang ke pula; metsi a diphoofolo ke tlhoko e arohaneng.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika ku byala hi mpfula ntsena. Tirhisa minkambelo ya swibyariwa swa ndhawu leyi leswi titshegeke hi mpfula; mati ya swifuwo i xilaveko xin’wana.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga u lima nga mvula fhedzi. Shumisani u ṱola zwiliṅwa zwa fhethu hafha zwi no ḓitika nga mvula; maḓi a zwifuwo ndi ṱhoḓea yo fhambanaho.

rows.english: Not recorded. Complete the site survey and confirm water before choosing an intensive plan.
rows.zu: Akurekhodiwe. Qedela inhlolovo yendawo bese uqinisekisa amanzi ngaphambi kokukhetha uhlelo oludinga izinsiza eziningi.
rows.st: Ha ho a rekotwa. Qetella phuputso ya sebaka mme o netefatse metsi pele o kgetha moralo o hlokang disebediswa tse ngata.
rows.ts: A swi rhekhodiwanga. Hetisa vulavisisi bya ndhawu u tiyisisa mati u nga si hlawula kungu leri lavaka switirhisiwa swo tala.
rows.ve: A zwo ngo rekhodwa. Fhedzisani ṱhoḓisiso ya fhethu ni khwaṱhisedze maḓi ni sa athu u nanga pulane ine ya ṱoḓa zwishumiswa zwinzhi.

rows.english: Farmer reports no observed frost. This observation does not establish that future winters will be frost-free.
rows.zu: Umlimi ubika ukuthi akabonanga isithwathwa. Lokhu akufakazeli ukuthi ubusika obuzayo ngeke bube nesithwathwa.
rows.st: Molemi o tlaleha hore ha a eso bone serame. Sena ha se tiise hore mariha a tlang a ke ke a ba le serame.
rows.ts: Murimi u vika leswaku a nga si vona rharhama. Ku vona loku a ku tiyisisi leswaku vuxika bya nkarhi lowu taka byi ta pfumala rharhama.
rows.ve: Mulimi u vhiga uri ha athu u vhona murotholo. Izwi a zwi khwaṱhisedzi uri vhuria vhu ḓaho a vhu nga vhi na murotholo.

rows.english: Local frost observations are not recorded. Satellite monthly averages cannot establish first and last frost dates.
rows.zu: Okubonwe ngesithwathwa endaweni akurekhodiwe. Izilinganiso zanyanga zonke zesathelayithi azikwazi ukuthola izinsuku zokuqala nezokugcina zesithwathwa.
rows.st: Se bonweng ka serame sebakeng ha se a rekotwa. Dikarolelano tsa kgwedi tsa sathelaete di ke ke tsa tiisa matsatsi a pele le a ho qetela a serame.
rows.ts: Leswi voniweke hi rharhama endhawini a swi rhekhodiwanga. Miringaniso ya n’hweti ya sathelayiti a yi koti ku tiyisisa masiku yo sungula ni yo hetelela ya rharhama.
rows.ve: Zwe zwa vhonwa nga murotholo wa henefho a zwo ngo rekhodwa. Zwikati zwa ṅwedzi zwa sathelaithi a zwi koni u khwaṱhisedza maḓuvha a murotholo wa u thoma na wa u fhedza.

rows.st: Phallo ya metsi: metsi a tswa hantle, ho ya ka tlaleho. Diphetho tsa teko ya mobu le ditlhoko tsa sejalo ka seng di ntse di hloka ho hlahlojwa.
rows.ts: Ku huma ka mati: mati ya huma kahle, hi ku vikiwa. Mbuyelo wa ku kambela misava ni swilaveko swa xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana swa ha fanele ku kamberiwa.
rows.ve: U bva ha maḓi: maḓi a bva zwavhuḓi, u ya nga muvhigo. Mvelelo dza u ṱola mavu na ṱhoḓea dza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa u ṱolwa.

rows.zu: Ukuphuma kwamanzi: kuhlala kumanzi, ngokubikiwe; hlola umhlabathi ngaphambi kokutshala. Kusadingeka ukuhlola imiphumela yokuhlolwa komhlabathi nezidingo zesitshalo ngasinye.
rows.st: Phallo ya metsi: mobu o dula o le metsi, ho ya ka tlaleho; hlahloba mobu pele o jala. Diphetho tsa teko ya mobu le ditlhoko tsa sejalo ka seng di ntse di hloka ho hlahlojwa.
rows.ts: Ku huma ka mati: misava yi tshamaka yi tsakama, hi ku vikiwa; kambela misava u nga si byala. Mbuyelo wa ku kambela misava ni swilaveko swa xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana swa ha fanele ku kamberiwa.
rows.ve: U bva ha maḓi: mavu a dzula o ṋukala, u ya nga muvhigo; ṱolani mavu ni sa athu u ṱavha. Mvelelo dza u ṱola mavu na ṱhoḓea dza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa u ṱolwa.

rows.zu: Lezi zitshalo ezihleliwe zizoba semhlabathini ezinyangeni lapho isithwathwa sibonakele lapha. Qinisekisa ukuvikelwa endaweni noma ushintshe ukutshala ngaphambi kokuthembela kulezi zinsuku.
rows.st: Dijalo tsena tse rerilweng di tla ba mobung dikgweding tseo serame se bonweng ka tsona mona. Netefatsa tshireletso ya sebaka kapa o fetole ho jala pele o itshetleha ka matsatsi ana.
rows.ts: Swibyariwa leswi kunguhatiweke swi ta va emhlabeni hi tin’hweti leti rharhama ri voniweke laha. Tiyisisa nsirhelelo wa ndhawu kumbe cinca mabyalelo u nga si titshega hi masiku lawa.
rows.ve: Zwiliṅwa izwi zwo pulanwaho zwi ḓo vha zwi mavuni nga miṅwedzi ye murotholo wa vhonwa hafha. Khwaṱhisedzani tsireledzo ya henefho kana ni shandule u ṱavha ni sa athu u ḓitika nga maḓuvha aya.

rows.english: The research has no matching regional shortlist. Ask a local grower or extension officer which named variety suits this season.
rows.zu: Ucwaningo alunalo uhlu olufushane oluhambisana nesifunda. Buza umlimi wendawo noma isikhulu sezolimo ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo olunegama olufanele lesi sikhathi.
rows.st: Dipatlisiso ha di na lenane le lekgutshwane le tsamaellanang le sebaka. Botsa molemi wa sebaka kapa ofisiri ya katoloso ya temo hore ke mofuta ofe o bitswang ka lebitso o loketseng nako ena.
rows.ts: Ndzavisiso a wu na nxaxamelo wo koma lowu fambelanaka ni xifundzha. Vutisa murimi wa ndhawu kumbe mutirhi wa ndzetelo wa vurimi leswaku i muxaka wihi lowu nga ni vito lowu faneleke nguva leyi.
rows.ve: Ṱhoḓisiso a i na mutevhe mupfufhi u yelanaho na dzingu. Vhudzisani mulimi wa henefho kana muofisiri wa thuso ya vhulimi uri ndi lushaka lufhio lu re na dzina lune lwa tea khalaṅwaha iyi.

rows.english: This site's climate has not resolved, so no local shortlist is claimed. Open the crop card to see sources and record your choice.
rows.zu: Isimo sezulu sale ndawo asikacaci, ngakho akukho hlu olufushane lwendawo olushiwo. Vula ikhadi lesitshalo ukuze ubone imithombo bese urekhoda okukhethile.
rows.st: Maemo a lehodimo a sebaka sena ha a eso hlake, kahoo ha ho bolelwe lenane le lekgutshwane la sebaka. Bula karete ya sejalo ho bona mehlodi le ho rekota kgetho ya hao.
rows.ts: Maxelo ya ndhawu leyi a ma si tiveka, kutani a ku vuriwi leswaku ku ni nxaxamelo wo koma wa ndhawu. Pfula khadi ra xibyariwa u vona swihlovo ni ku rhekhoda xihlawuriwa xa wena.
rows.ve: Kilima ya fhethu hafha a i athu u ṱalutshedzea, ngauralo a hu buliwi mutevhe mupfufhi wa henefho. Vulani garaṱa ya tshiliṅwa u vhona zwiko na u rekhoda zwe na nanga.

rows.english: Food-use review: kept as mapped inventory; the verified product is not household food. No ordinary food availability or production is assumed.
rows.zu: Ukubuyekezwa kokusetshenziswa njengokudla: kugcinwa ohlwini lwemephu; umkhiqizo oqinisekisiwe awukona ukudla kwasekhaya. Akucatshangwa ukutholakala noma ukukhiqizwa kokudla okuvamile.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya tshebediso e le dijo: se bolokwa lethathamong la mmapa; sehlahiswa se netefaditsweng ha se dijo tsa lelapa. Ha ho nahannwe boteng kapa tlhahiso e tlwaelehileng ya dijo.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wa ku tirhisiwa ku ri swakudya: swi hlayisiwa eka nxaxamelo wa mepe; xikumiwa lexi tiyisisiweke a hi swakudya swa le kaya. A ku ehleketiwi ku kumeka kumbe vuhumelerisi bya swakudya swa ntolovelo.
rows.ve: U sedzulusa tshumiso ya zwiḽiwa: zwi vhulungwa kha mutevhe wa mapa; tshibveledzwa tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho a si zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa. A hu humbulelwi u wanala kana vhubveledzi ha zwiḽiwa zwo ḓoweleaho.

rows.english: Food-use review: confirm identity, edible part and appropriate preparation with a qualified local adviser before including this plant as household food. Held out of ordinary food totals and picking jobs.
rows.zu: Ukubuyekezwa kokusetshenziswa njengokudla: qinisekisa ubunikazi, ingxenye edliwayo nokulungiswa okufanele nomeluleki wendawo oqeqeshiwe ngaphambi kokufaka lesi sitshalo ekudleni kwasekhaya. Asibalwa ezambeni zokudla okuvamile nasemisebenzini yokuvuna.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya tshebediso e le dijo: netefatsa hore ke semela sefe, karolo e jewang le tokiso e nepahetseng le moeletsi wa sebaka ya nang le tsebo pele o se kenya dijong tsa lelapa. Se tlohetswe dikakaretsong tsa dijo tse tlwaelehileng le mesebetsing ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wa ku tirhisiwa ku ri swakudya: tiyisisa leswaku i ximilana xihi, xiphemu lexi dyiwaka ni malunghiselelo lama faneleke ni mutsundzuxi wa ndhawu loyi a nga ni vutivi u nga si xi katsa eka swakudya swa le kaya. A xi katsiwanga eka tinhlayo ta swakudya swa ntolovelo ni mintirho yo tshovela.
rows.ve: U sedzulusa tshumiso ya zwiḽiwa: khwaṱhisedzani vhuvha, tshipiḓa tshi ḽiwaho na u lugisela ho teaho na mueletshedzi wa henefho a re na ndalukanyo ni sa athu u katela tshimela itshi kha zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa. A tshi katelwi kha zwivhalo zwa zwiḽiwa zwo ḓoweleaho na mishumo ya u kaṋa.

rows.english: Count assumption: {count} banana circle(s) × 3 planted bananas. Followers are not additional planted trees.
rows.zu: Ukucatshangwa kwesibalo: iziyingi zikabhanana ezingu-{count} × obhanana abatshaliwe abangu-3. Amahlumela alandelayo awazona izihlahla ezengeziwe ezitshaliwe.
rows.st: Kakanyo ya palo: didikadikwe tse {count} tsa banana × dibanana tse 3 tse jetsweng. Mahlomela a latelang ha se difate tse ding tse jetsweng.
rows.ts: Ku ehleketela nhlayo: swirhendzevutana swa mabanana swa {count} × mabanana ya 3 lama byariweke. Mahluke lama landzelaka a hi mirhi yin’wana leyi byariweke.
rows.ve: U humbulela tshivhalo: zwitendeledzi zwa miomva zwa {count} × miomva yo ṱavhiwaho ya 3. Makhule a tevhelaho a si miṅwe miri yo ṱavhiwaho.

rows.english: Cold-area check: these subtropical references do not establish suitability here. Confirm a frost-protected position before buying.
rows.zu: Ukuhlola indawo ebandayo: lezi zinkomba zezindawo ezifudumele azifakazeli ukufaneleka lapha. Qinisekisa indawo evikelekile esithwathweni ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya sebaka se batang: ditshupiso tsena tsa dibaka tse futhumetseng ha di tiise hore ho loketse mona. Netefatsa sebaka se sireleditsweng serameng pele o reka.
rows.ts: Nkambelo wa ndhawu yo titimela: swikombo leswi swa tindhawu leti kufumelaka a swi tiyisisi leswaku swi fanele laha. Tiyisisa ndhawu leyi sirhelelekeke eka rharhama u nga si xava.
rows.ve: U ṱola fhethu hu rotholelaho: ndaedzi idzi dza vhupo vhu dudelaho a dzi khwaṱhisedzi uri zwi tea hafha. Khwaṱhisedzani fhethu ho tsireledzwaho kha murotholo ni sa athu u renga.

rows.english: Assumed planting variety: Grand Nain for a warm site; use the wind/cold alternatives in the buying advice if those conditions apply. Local picking months remain unconfirmed.
rows.zu: Uhlobo olucatshangwayo lokutshala: Grand Nain endaweni efudumele; sebenzisa ezinye izinketho zomoya/amakhaza ezelulekweni zokuthenga uma lezo zimo zikhona. Izinyanga zokuvuna zendawo azikaqinisekiswa.
rows.st: Mofuta o nahannweng wa ho jala: Grand Nain bakeng sa sebaka se futhumetseng; sebedisa mefuta e meng bakeng sa moya/serame e keletsong ya ho reka haeba maemo ao a le teng. Dikgwedi tsa kotulo tsa sebaka ha di eso netefatswe.
rows.ts: Muxaka lowu ehleketeleriwaka ku byariwa: Grand Nain eka ndhawu yo kufumela; tirhisa swihlawuriwa swin’wana swa moya/ku titimela leswi nga eka switsundzuxo swo xava loko ku ri ni swiyimo swoleswo. Tin’hweti to tshovela ta ndhawu a ti si tiyisisiwa.
rows.ve: Lushaka lu humbulelwaho u ṱavhiwa: Grand Nain kha fhethu hu dudelaho; shumisani dziṅwe nḓila dza muya/murotho dzi re kha nyeletshedzo ya u renga arali nyimele idzo dzi hone. Miṅwedzi ya henefho ya u kaṋa a i athu u khwaṱhisedzwa.

rows.english: Assumed planting variety: Sunrise Solo, subject to a frost-free, drained growing position. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
rows.zu: Uhlobo olucatshangwayo lokutshala: Sunrise Solo, uma indawo yokukhula ingenayo isithwathwa futhi amanzi ephuma. Qinisekisa izinyanga zalo zokuvuna endaweni; ikhalenda lisebenzisa inkomba yesifunda ephawuliwe lapho inomthombo.
rows.st: Mofuta o nahannweng wa ho jala: Sunrise Solo, ha feela sebaka sa ho hola se se na serame mme metsi a tswa. Netefatsa dikgwedi tsa wona tsa kotulo sebakeng; khalendara e sebedisa tshupiso ya sebaka e tshwailweng moo ho nang le mohlodi.
rows.ts: Muxaka lowu ehleketeleriwaka ku byariwa: Sunrise Solo, loko ndhawu yo kula yi pfumala rharhama naswona mati ya huma. Tiyisisa tin’hweti ta wona to tshovela endhawini; khalendara yi tirhisa xikombo xa xifundzha lexi funghiweke laha ku nga ni xihlovo.
rows.ve: Lushaka lu humbulelwaho u ṱavhiwa: Sunrise Solo, arali fhethu ha u aluwa hu si na murotholo nahone maḓi a bva. Khwaṱhisedzani miṅwedzi yalwo ya u kaṋa henefho; khalenda i shumisa ndaedzi ya dzingu yo vhewaho dzina hune tshiko tsha vha hone.

rows.english: Assumed planting variety: Tommy Atkins, subject to local flowering and frost checks. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
rows.zu: Uhlobo olucatshangwayo lokutshala: Tommy Atkins, kuye ngokuhlolwa kokuqhakaza nesithwathwa endaweni. Qinisekisa izinyanga zalo zokuvuna endaweni; ikhalenda lisebenzisa inkomba yesifunda ephawuliwe lapho inomthombo.
rows.st: Mofuta o nahannweng wa ho jala: Tommy Atkins, ho ya ka ditlhahlobo tsa dipalesa le serame sebakeng. Netefatsa dikgwedi tsa wona tsa kotulo sebakeng; khalendara e sebedisa tshupiso ya sebaka e tshwailweng moo ho nang le mohlodi.
rows.ts: Muxaka lowu ehleketeleriwaka ku byariwa: Tommy Atkins, hi ku ya hi minkambelo ya ku rhumbuka ni rharhama ya ndhawu. Tiyisisa tin’hweti ta wona to tshovela endhawini; khalendara yi tirhisa xikombo xa xifundzha lexi funghiweke laha ku nga ni xihlovo.
rows.ve: Lushaka lu humbulelwaho u ṱavhiwa: Tommy Atkins, u ya nga u ṱola maluvha na murotholo wa henefho. Khwaṱhisedzani miṅwedzi yalwo ya u kaṋa henefho; khalenda i shumisa ndaedzi ya dzingu yo vhewaho dzina hune tshiko tsha vha hone.

rows.english: Buying advice: a named variety for this area is not sourced. Confirm cultivar, pollination and local suitability before purchasing.
rows.zu: Iseluleko sokuthenga: alukho uhlobo olunegama lwale ndawo olunomthombo. Qinisekisa uhlobo, impova nokufaneleka endaweni ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Keletso ya ho reka: ha ho mohlodi wa mofuta o bitswang ka lebitso bakeng sa sebaka sena. Netefatsa mofuta, ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa le ho lokela ha sebaka pele o reka.
rows.ts: Xitsundzuxo xo xava: a ku na xihlovo xa muxaka lowu nga ni vito wa ndhawu leyi. Tiyisisa muxaka, ku hundziseriwa ka pholeni ni ku faneleka ka ndhawu u nga si xava.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya u renga: lushaka lu re na dzina lwa fhethu hafha a lu na tshiko. Khwaṱhisedzani lushaka, u phaḓaladzwa ha muvhere na u tea ha fhethu ni sa athu u renga.

rows.english: Edible bananas set fruit without pollination.
rows.zu: Obhanana abadliwayo bakha izithelo ngaphandle kokudluliswa kwempova.
rows.st: Dibanana tse jewang di beha ditholwana ntle le ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa.
rows.ts: Mabanana lama dyiwaka ma veka mihandzu handle ko hundziseriwa ka pholeni.
rows.ve: Miomva i ḽiwaho i aṋwa mitshelo hu si na u phaḓaladzwa ha muvhere.

rows.zu: Impova: {type}. Hlola izidingo zohlobo olukhethiwe nenkulisa yezitshalo.
rows.st: Ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa: {type}. Hlahloba ditlhoko tsa mofuta o kgethilweng le sebaka sa kgodiso ya dimela.
rows.ts: Ku hundziseriwa ka pholeni: {type}. Kambela swilaveko swa muxaka lowu hlawuriweke ni ndhawu yo kurisa swimilana.
rows.ve: U phaḓaladzwa ha muvhere: {type}. Ṱolani ṱhoḓea dza lushaka lwo nangwaho na nesari.

rows.english: Expected picking season: no single local cultivar window established. Reference seasons below are not a forecast.
rows.zu: Isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelwe: alukho uhlobo olulodwa lwendawo olunefasitela eliqinisekisiwe. Izikhathi eziyizinkomba ezingezansi azisona isibikezelo.
rows.st: Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho nako e le nngwe e tiisitsweng ya mofuta wa sebaka. Dinako tsa ditshupiso tse ka tlase ha se ponelopele.
rows.ts: Nguva yo tshovela leyi languteriweke: a ku si tiyisisiwa nkarhi wun’we wa muxaka wa ndhawu. Tinguva ta swikombo leswi nga laha hansi a hi mvhumbo.
rows.ve: Khalaṅwaha ya u kaṋa yo lavhelelwaho: a hu athu u khwaṱhisedzwa tshifhinga tshithihi tsha lushaka lwa henefho. Khalaṅwaha dza ndaedzi dzi re afho fhasi a si mbonelaphanḓa.

rows.english: Expected picking season: no fixed regional months sourced. Record planting and picking dates locally.
rows.zu: Isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelwe: azikho izinyanga ezimisiwe zesifunda ezinomthombo. Rekhoda izinsuku zokutshala nezokuvuna endaweni.
rows.st: Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho mohlodi wa dikgwedi tse tsitsitseng tsa sebaka. Rekota matsatsi a ho jala le kotulo sebakeng.
rows.ts: Nguva yo tshovela leyi languteriweke: a ku na xihlovo xa tin’hweti leti vekiweke ta xifundzha. Rhekhoda masiku yo byala ni yo tshovela endhawini.
rows.ve: Khalaṅwaha ya u kaṋa yo lavhelelwaho: a hu na tshiko tsha miṅwedzi yo tiwaho ya dzingu. Rekhodani maḓuvha a u ṱavha na a u kaṋa henefho.

rows.zu: Isithwathwa esibonakele siyaphikisana nale nkomba ehlongozwayo; qinisekisa indawo yokukhula evikelekile ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Serame se bonweng se hanana le tshupiso ena e sisintsweng; netefatsa sebaka se sireleditsweng sa ho hola pele o reka.
rows.ts: Rharhama leri voniweke ri lwisana ni xikombo lexi ringanyetiweke; tiyisisa ndhawu yo kula leyi sirhelelekeke u nga si xava.
rows.ve: Murotholo wo vhonwaho u lwisana na ndaedzi iyi yo dzinginywaho; khwaṱhisedzani fhethu ha u aluwa ho tsireledzwaho ni sa athu u renga.

rows.ts: Miako ya {existing} leyi nga kona; ya {proposed} leyi ringanyetiweke. A ku ehleketiwi nhlayo ya swifuwo kumbe masiku ya vuhumelerisi.
